summary_zh.result: 密度梯度点阵结构比均匀密度结构具有更可预测的变形行为和更高的能量吸收。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜观察断口形貌，并与有限元模拟结果对比验证。

title: Compression behaviour of cellular structures produced by selective laser beam additive manufacturing: X-ray tomography based finite element and experimental approaches
venue: Digital Access to Libraries (Université catholique de Louvain (UCL), l'Université de Namur (UNamur) and the Université Saint-Louis (USL-B))
relevance_to_user: 该论文的研究方法（LPBF多孔结构制造与力学测试）可迁移到生物医用植入物的应力屏蔽分析，但未直接针对该方向。
why_not_core: Does not link porous structures to stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, and no biomedical context such as osseointegration or surface roughness.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光选区熔化制造的多孔结构压缩行为
summary_zh.method: 结合X射线断层扫描和基于图像的有限元模型，考虑非均匀孔隙率
summary_zh.result: 非均匀模型与实验结果吻合较好
summary_zh.validation: 原位和离位X射线断层扫描验证

title: Compressed Sensing with Sparse Corruptions: Fault-Tolerant Sparse Collocation Approximations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的稀疏压缩感知方法可用于处理代理模型训练中的异常测量值，提高不确定性量化鲁棒性，但未直接应用于生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modelling for implant biomechanics, nor does it handle multi-objective constraints or patient-specific design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决UQ中测量值被稀疏污染导致恢复精度下降的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出正则化ℓ1最小化算法及迭代重加权优化方法
summary_zh.result: 在中高维参数化PDE算例中验证了方法的鲁棒性和有效性
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个参数化微分方程数值算例验证

title: Collared Vs. Collarless Total Hip Arthroplasty In Both Direct Anterior And Direct Lateral Approach Surgery: A Prospective Cohort Comparison Study
relevance_to_user: 该论文关注股骨柄的领圈设计对术后下沉的影响，但未涉及应力遮挡或有限元分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion via FEA, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it is a clinical migration study without biomechanical modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较有领和无领股骨柄在直接前路和直接外侧入路中的术后下沉差异。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性队列研究，使用RSA评估术后2-4周内的股骨柄迁移。
summary_zh.result: 无领柄下沉显著大于有领柄，但患者报告结果无差异。
summary_zh.validation: 临床RSA测量验证。

title: Characteristics of Biometallic Alloy to Additive Manufacturing Using Selective Laser Melting Technology

why_not_core: No porous structure for stress shielding mitigation, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.method: 气雾化粉末分级表征并SLM制备拉伸试样

title: Adaptive Selection of Gaussian Process Model for Active Learning in Expensive Optimization.

title: Active learning methods for reliability analysis of engineering systems
